description: Create a note at a path you choose under Notes/ or Captures/, or replace one there with overwrite=true. Use it for hubs, guides and runbooks maintained by hand. Unlike brain_capture you set the type, including 'hub': a hub groups every note whose frontmatter project matches its title. Generated notes elsewhere in the vault cannot be written. The reply lists existing notes the body names without linking.

body.description: Markdown body, without frontmatter or the # title heading. Link related notes inside the sentence that says how they relate.

order.description: Position among Notes/ guides on Start Here

overwrite.description: Replace the note if the path already exists

project.description: Hub this note belongs to, e.g. 'Harbor Ledger'

summary.description: One line; Start Here shows it next to Notes/ guides

type.description: note, hub, moc, guide, runbook, plan, decision, ...

name: brain_write
title: Create or replace a hand-written note
